title: Normalized mixed reduction tensor unit
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, $E,L$ finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, $\iota:E\hookrightarrow L$ a coefficient embedding, $W$ a scheme, and $n\geq0$. Use the completed coefficient sheaves and reductions of [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower] and the ordinary and completed scalar extensions of [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension]. Put $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/(\varpi_E^{n+1})$ and let $\iota_n:A_{E,n}\to A_{L,n}$ be the induced quotient map. There is a unique natural transformation from reduction over $E$ to ordinary scalar extension to $L$, then reduction over $L$ and restriction along $\iota_n$, given on sheafified tensor sections by $s\otimes x\mapsto\iota_n(s)\otimes(1\otimes x)$. Define this transformation by the unique formula, and take its homotopy-category transformation with the indicated functor associators.

Its derived transformation is uniquely specified on every homotopy-category object by the square using the universal derived-reduction counits of [lem-weil-derived-scalar-extension-restriction-adjunction] and the exact-functor factorization isomorphisms for ordinary scalar extension and restriction. Define the derived unit using this unique specification. Compose it with reduction and restriction of the prescribed ordinary-to-completed diagonal Roos map of [lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension]. This defines the mixed completed reduction unit, from reduction over $E$ to restriction of reduction over $L$ of completed scalar extension, retaining the quotient augmentation and the shifted coordinate of that normalized completion map.
